profile_text: With a focus on travel and tourism, this Düsseldorf-based firm specializes in organizing and booking flights, leveraging its administrative expertise to support a wide range of travel services. As a Scaler, the company has achieved modest growth of 0.6% since its baseline, driven by its ability to navigate the complex and competitive travel industry. With nearly 3,000 employees, the company's central administration and management team, located at Berger Allee 15, play a crucial role in coordinating its operations and driving expansion.
